purpose: Governed reusable intelligence for identifying, separating, associating, validating and resolving commodity-description evidence without performing the transaction.
boundary: Atlas supplies governed identification/resolution intelligence; runtime consumers observe transaction evidence and execute.

cardinality_rules: Preserve each positively established CommodityItem; do not collapse multiple commodities into one description.
HandlingUnit, Package and CommodityItem are distinct concepts; do not infer one-to-one equivalence.
A printed line/sequence number is not a CommodityItem identifier unless its semantic role is established.

positive_signals: Text occupying a commodity/article/description position or group in shipment evidence.
Text associated with a CommodityItem and corroborated by neighboring package quantity/type, weight, NMFC item/subitem, freight class or dangerous-goods evidence.
Article/commodity wording that can be tested against applicable NMFC provisions where classification validation is required.
non_rules: Do not identify description solely from page coordinates or a fixed template.
Do not assume pallet/skid count equals commodity count.
Do not assume Handling Unit Line No equals Commodity Item Number.

rules.statement: Commodity Description is semantically distinct from handling-unit, package, weight, NMFC, class and dangerous-goods attributes; compound evidence must be decomposed before association.
Multiple positively established commodities require separately represented CommodityItem descriptions; preserve source cardinality.
HandlingUnit, Package and CommodityItem are distinct. Do not force 1:1 relationships; retain evidence-supported associations.

When choosing among applicable NMFC descriptions, a specific applicable description takes precedence over a more general description only when the article/material is embraced by the specific description; evaluate relevant headings, subheadings, notes, exceptions and references.
Packaging/form of shipment is a separate concept but may be material evidence for commodity identification/classification and applicable packaging provisions.
Preserve observed description text even when vague or abbreviated. Semantic field identification does not imply classification sufficiency; never fabricate a more specific commodity description.
ClassIT+ is authoritative acquisition/validation infrastructure but API lookup alone is not complete contextual resolution; structured subitem-selection logic is not currently supplied.
When unresolved, return the observed value, unresolved reason and pointed additional evidence needed instead of generic guessing/HITL.

external_knowledge.lifecycle: bounded acquisition → source snapshot/reference → provenance/version/effective-date/licence controls → normalize → validate → promote → reuse
external_knowledge.mutation_policy: Execution-learned information is candidate evidence and MUST NOT silently mutate canonical Atlas knowledge.

unresolved_non_blocking.question: Exact universal semantics of Handling Unit Line No and when it is an association key versus sequence.
unresolved_non_blocking.policy: Do not equate with CommodityItem identifier without source/client evidence.

unresolved_non_blocking.question: Universal precedence/association semantics for continuation BOLs and external commodity attachments.
unresolved_non_blocking.policy: Support additional evidence structurally; do not invent universal precedence.

consumer_contract.malkom_projection: Malkom may consume this contract to configure/apply commodity-description contextualization, validation, exception/HITL and master/external-lookup behavior; Malkom runtime constructs are not canonical Atlas semantics.
consumer_contract.non_malkom_projection: A VLM/agent/document-digitization workflow can consume the same generic input/output and rule set without Malkom queues, schemas or APIs.

MALKOM_UTILITY.evidence: Contract specifies what a Malkom implementation needs to identify, separate, associate, validate and escalate BOL-002 rather than rediscovering those domain rules.

CONSUMER_INDEPENDENCE.evidence: Canonical contract contains no Malkom queue/API/runtime dependency and defines a second VLM/agent/document-digitization projection.

sufficiency.rationale: Field-specific identification/resolution chain is now explicit and adversarially testable; freeze remains blocked on independent QA and unresolved questions remain fail-closed rather than guessed.

provenance.claim: Specific applicable description precedence; consider complete item, notes, exceptions and references.

provenance.claim: Defines additional evidence useful to resolve commodity identity/classification.
Structured logic for subitem selection is not currently implemented.
Separates handling unit, package, commodity description, NMFC and class attributes.
BOL/shipping-paper freight description and quantity/weight requirements.
Conditional hazardous-material description grammar and qualifiers.
